name: Skills
description: Discover agent skills — named bundles of instructions, context, tools, and further skills. Pick command='list' to render an index, or command='read' for one full skill. Sources are skillsets (directories such as w/skills or v/skills/root); name individual skills with the skills input instead. Both default to this venue's configured entry point (see v/info/adapters/skills). Read-only — author with the lattice write and asset store operations.

sources.description: Skillsets to search — directory paths whose keys are skill names. Defaults to this venue's configured entry skillsets (see v/info/adapters/skills), normally ["w/skills", "v/skills/root"]. Earlier sources shadow same-named later skills.

skills.description: Individual skills to include — paths to one skill, or content-addressed asset refs. Distinct from sources, which names directories.

name.description: read only: a skill name from the index, looked up across the sources and skills given.

ref.description: read only: direct skill address (a/<hash>, v/skills/<x>, w/skills/<x>) — alternative to name.

output.description: list → the skill index text (one '- name — description' line per skill, '(loaded)' on skills already in context, '- name — INVALID: reason' on a broken one), or null when the sources yield nothing. read → {name, description, path, id, tools, body?, skills?, skillsets?, context?}. id is the skill's content identity (the value hash of its resolved metadata) — two addresses with the same id are the same skill. tools are operation refs added to the palette while loaded. skills and skillsets are the individual skills and the directories of skills this skill makes discoverable while it is loaded. body is present when the skill has content (a contentless skill is a pure toolset). context is its bundled context entries.
